welcome_message:
Create an AAI experiment starter project

A local-first, reproducible MLflow experiment: dataset lineage, governed tags, metrics, artifacts, and a deterministic release gate. No LLMs involved.

project_name.description: Project and bundle name. NOTE: apply template updates deliberately — generated projects record their template version in .aai-template.json
project_name.pattern_match_failure_message: Use lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens.

application_name.description: Application identifier used in tags and traces

repository_url.description: Required absolute HTTPS URL of this project's real Git repository; Hub registration rejects example and placeholder URLs
repository_url.pattern_match_failure_message: Use an absolute HTTPS repository URL without credentials, spaces, a query string, or a fragment.

experiment_name.description: Descriptive MLflow experiment path naming the application and decision purpose

include_notebook.description: Include an exploration notebook (notebooks stay exploratory; production logic lives in src/)

aai_core_volume.description: Unity Catalog volume holding aai-core wheels

uat_workspace_host.description: UAT Azure Databricks workspace; its identity, grants, and GitHub environment are provisioned externally

aai_core_source_ref.description: Immutable SDK source ref used only by credential-free CI: an exact release-candidate commit, or the annotated v<version> tag after publication

aai_core_pip_source.description: pip-installable aai-core source used only by credential-free CI; its immutable ref is governed by aai_core_source_ref. Runtime jobs never use this source and require the separately published checksum-pinned volume wheel

success_message:
{{.project_name}} created.

Next steps:
  1. cd {{.project_name}}
  2. python3.12 scripts/setup_dev.py # preflight + isolated setup
  3. make check                      # hermetic tests + deterministic gate
  4. python jobs/run_experiment.py   # first tracked run
  5. make evaluate                   # the release gate

Run `make help` for every available target.
